threshold: No loss of relevant canonical chunk IDs per currently answerable development case; no new nonempty retrieval on unanswerable cases whose baseline is empty.
alias_policy: Map reviewed excerpt IDs to original evidence IDs; duplicates never earn extra recall credit. Evaluate the actual top six returned hits, without filling positions removed by deduplication.
expired_evidence: Cases with any unavailable labelled evidence are reported as not comparable, never silently removed or counted as passes.
quality_scope: Self-authored source-labelled development regression; lexical engineering only, not independent semantic quality or hybrid ranking validation.
